title: Valence-dependent functional connectivity during vicarious observation of hostile and affiliative social interactions.
summary: Social environment profoundly influences well-being, yet the neural correlates of vicariously observing workplace interactions across the emotional spectrum remain underexplored. This study investigated valence-dependent patterns of functional connectivity (FC) during observation of hostile and affiliative customer-employee encounters in thirty-four healthy adults. Seed-based FC analysis examined the connectivity of key regions associated with empathy and relational social cognitive processing, and region-of-interest (ROI)-to-ROI analysis evaluated the configuration of three core brain networks. Results revealed that witnessing hostility, compared to affiliation, was associated with greater connectivity within the salience network, a system typically involved in vigilance, and increased coupling between core empathy regions and sensory areas. Conversely, relative to hostile conditions, observing affiliation was associated with greater integration within the default mode and frontoparietal networks. Furthermore, exploratory analysis revealed that emotion regulation strategies were associated with these pathways, in which cognitive reappraisal was linked to reduced empathy-sensory coupling during hostility, while expressive suppression was associated with broadly reduced empathy-related connectivity particularly during positive observation. These findings indicate that functional brain organization differs depending on the valence of observed social interactions, with potential relevance for understanding how workplace social dynamics may influence neural processing. This work bridges social neuroscience with organizational behavior, highlighting directions for future research on vicarious stress and well-being.

标题：观察敌意与亲和性社会互动时效价依赖的功能连接
摘要：社会环境深刻影响个体福祉，然而对工作场所互动进行替代性观察时跨越情绪谱系的神经相关物仍研究不足。本研究考察了三十四名健康成年人在观察敌意性与亲和性顾客—员工互动时效价依赖的功能连接（FC）模式。基于种子点的FC分析检验了与共情及关系性社会认知加工相关的关键区域的连接性，感兴趣区（ROI）到ROI分析评估了三个核心脑网络的配置。结果显示，与亲和性条件相比，目睹敌意与突显网络内部更强的连接性相关，该系统通常参与警觉，同时核心共情区域与感觉区之间的耦合增强。相反，相对于敌意条件，观察亲和性与默认模式网络和额顶网络内部更大的整合相关。此外，探索性分析显示情绪调节策略与这些通路相关，其中认知重评与敌意条件下共情—感觉耦合的降低相关，而表达抑制则与共情相关连接性的广泛降低相关，尤其是在积极观察期间。这些发现表明，功能性脑组织因所观察社会互动的效价而异，这对于理解工作场所社会动态如何影响神经加工具有潜在意义。本研究 bridging 社会神经科学与组织行为学，凸显了未来关于替代性压力与福祉研究的方向。
关键词：功能连接；社会互动；共情；情绪调节；社会神经科学

title: Domain adaptation spatial feature perception neural network for cross-subject EEG emotion recognition
summary: Emotion recognition is a critical research topic within affective computing, with potential applications across various domains. Currently, EEG-based emotion recognition, utilizing deep learning frameworks, has been effectively applied and achieved commendable performance. However, existing deep learning-based models face challenges in capturing both the spatial activity features and spatial topology features of EEG signals simultaneously. To address this challenge, a domain-adaptation spatial-feature perception-network has been proposed for cross-subject EEG emotion recognition tasks, named DSP-EmotionNet. Firstly, a spatial activity topological feature extractor module has been designed to capture spatial activity features and spatial topology features of EEG signals, named SATFEM. Then, using SATFEM as the feature extractor, DSP-EmotionNet has been designed, significantly improving the accuracy of the model in cross-subject EEG emotion recognition tasks. The proposed model surpasses state-of-the-art methods in cross-subject EEG emotion recognition tasks, achieving an average recognition accuracy of 82.5% on the SEED dataset and 65.9% on the SEED-IV dataset.

标题：面向跨被试脑电情绪识别的域自适应空间特征感知神经网络
摘要：情绪识别是情感计算中的一个关键研究课题，在多个领域具有潜在应用。目前，基于深度学习的脑电情绪识别已被有效应用并取得了良好性能。然而，现有基于深度学习的模型在同时捕捉脑电信号的空间活动特征和空间拓扑特征方面面临挑战。为解决这一问题，提出了一种用于跨被试脑电情绪识别任务的域自适应空间特征感知网络，命名为DSP-EmotionNet。首先，设计了一个空间活动拓扑特征提取器模块，用于捕捉脑电信号的空间活动特征和空间拓扑特征，命名为SATFEM。然后，以SATFEM作为特征提取器，设计了DSP-EmotionNet，显著提高了模型在跨被试脑电情绪识别任务中的准确率。所提出的模型在跨被试脑电情绪识别任务中超越了最先进的方法，在SEED数据集上实现了82.5%的平均识别准确率，在SEED-IV数据集上实现了65.9%的平均识别准确率。
关键词：脑电情绪识别；跨被试；域自适应；空间特征感知；深度学习
